Beyond Tourism. Engineered for Safety & Certainty.

Java Volcano Tour Operator (JVTO) is a registered Indonesian travel company based in Bondowoso and led by an active Tourist Police officer. We design private, all-inclusive itineraries to Mount Bromo, Ijen Crater and Tumpak Sewu with clear safety rules, transparent pricing and real local impact.

Leadership Spotlight

The Authority Behind The Expedition.

Meet Agung Sambuko (Mr. Sam), widely known as Mr. Sam. He is the architect of JVTO's safety-first philosophy and an active officer in the Ditpamobvit (Directorate of Vital Object Security) of the Indonesian National Police.

His role changes how JVTO handles private routes. Safety decisions stay operational, Ijen seriousness is surfaced early, and guests are pointed toward proof before payment instead of being asked to trust the brand blindly.

Private-Only Handling

Routes are designed around dedicated handling, clear transfer logic, and adult decision-making rather than shared-tour shortcuts.

Proof Ownership

Legal, police-safety, review, and history pages stay separated so guests can check claims directly before moving toward booking.
